heroDescription: Explore 73 components and layout entries. Adjust parameters, try real NuxtUI Go components, and take the code into your application.
installNote: Requires Go 1.27.3+; build native applications with CGO_ENABLED=0.
exampleDefault: The panel shows example settings; API zero values may differ from the example settings.
noParameters: This entry uses a composition example. Use the theme controls above.
copyFailed: Clipboard access failed. Select the code to copy it.
codeHint: Save the complete example as main.go. Initialize a Go module, add the dependency, then run it.
defaultCode: Parameters are not synchronized yet. Showing the last confirmed configuration, or the default example on first load.
optionHint: Pass a value of this type. See the complete example for usage.
optionalHint: Unset inherits the component default. Use nui.Set for an explicit false, zero or empty value.
callbackHint: An application callback. The example demonstrates one integration.
platformNote: Previews run the same Go components through WASM. Fonts, system input and native file dialogs can differ from desktop behavior. Browser previews do not yet expose full screen-reader semantics.
footer: Built on MyGo · Nuxt UI visual style · MIT
imageSize: Images must be smaller than 2 MB.
